basis: Peripheral axonal/demyelinating neuropathy; muscle wasting and foot deformities follow denervation rather than direct musculoskeletal disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: distal weakness, wasting and secondary foot deformities reflect denervation; direct muscle or skeletal disease is not established.

basis: Lysosomal storage disease; developmental delay and dysostosis 80-99%, cataracts 30-79%. Hearing impairment 30-79% omitted by cap; hepatosplenomegaly 5-29%.

decisions.neurologic: involved: CNS storage disease causes developmental delay in 80-99% and seizures in 30-79%; the defining disorder is metabolic.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: dysostosis multiplex documents direct skeletal disease in 80-99%, accompanying the defining metabolic storage disorder.

basis: Plasma-cell disorder, neuropathy and endocrinopathy define POEMS; sclerotic bone lesions occur in ~90-95% and are major criteria. Common skin and vascular involvement omitted by cap.

decisions.dermatologic: none: persistent skin changes are common, but bone lesions occur in ~90-95% and are a major diagnostic criterion; skin is omitted by the four-organ cap.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: osteosclerotic lesions directly occupy bone, occur in ~90-95%, and are a major diagnostic criterion.

basis: Developmental and intellectual impairment define the syndrome; strabismus occurs in 30-79%. Feeding problems lack direct GI pathology; hydronephrosis occurs in 25%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: feeding difficulty and oropharyngeal dysphagia accompany neurologic dysfunction; direct gastrointestinal damage is not established.

basis: Steroid synthesis defect with hypogonadism; osteoporosis/low bone density and structural urethral hypospadias are each annotated 80-99%.

decisions.renal: involved: hypospadias is a congenital urethral malformation annotated in 80-99%; the urethra explicitly belongs to the renal axis.

basis: Respiratory-chain metabolic defect; weakness and pathological muscle fibers establish myopathy in 2/2. Neonatal respiratory distress alone does not establish pulmonary damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: weakness and biopsy-confirmed muscle pathology occur in 2/2; muscle is directly affected by the defining mitochondrial metabolic disorder.

basis: Anal fibroepithelial polyp; perianal skin is an alternative origin without evidence that cutaneous disease applies to most cases.

decisions.dermatologic: none: perianal skin is an alternative site; this anal-polyp umbrella does not establish cutaneous origin or involvement in most patients.

basis: Inherited distal motor neuron or axonal degeneration; muscle weakness and wasting result from denervation.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: common distal muscle wasting is secondary to motor neuron/axon degeneration; direct muscle or skeletal disease is not established.

basis: Dental developmental defects define the syndrome; ancestry identifies an endocrine growth disorder. Strabismus frequency and major-criterion status are unestablished.

decisions.ocular: none: strabismus appears in a related synonym, but neither a frequency of at least 30% nor major diagnostic-criterion status is established.

basis: Skeletal dysplasia and sensory/autonomic dysfunction are core; visual dysfunction occurs in 80-99%. Respiratory insufficiency lacks evidence of direct pulmonary damage.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory insufficiency (6/6) can reflect dysautonomia and skeletal restriction; direct lung or airway disease is not established.
